description:
Ses Açma - Piano Warm Up gets your voice ready with piano-accompanied warm-ups, trains your ear and prepares you for music school entrance exams. Made for singing students, singers, choir members and teachers.

WARM-UP
Each round starts with a chord, then the exercise plays and rises a half step. The syllables to sing are on screen and the notes light up on the keyboard.
• 6 exercises: Humming, Five-Note Ladder, Staccato, Arpeggio, Octave Leap, Nine-Note Scale
• Voice types: Child, Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass
• Set the starting and highest notes, tempo 60–160 BPM, up only or up and down
• Turn off the melody to sing by ear over the chord

EAR TRAINING
• Find the note on the keyboard
• Name the interval
• Which note is higher?
• Recognise major, minor, augmented and diminished chords
• Sing it back: hear a note or melody and sing it
• Ear test: 15 short questions that measure your level and show what to practise

CONSERVATORY PREP
Practice in the style of music school entrance exams:
• Catch the note, two notes, three notes
• Melody memory and rhythm echo
• Mock exam: limited listens, no feedback until the end, then a score for pitch, melodic memory and rhythm

GREEN LIGHT WHILE YOU SING
Turn on the microphone and the app listens as you sing. The light turns green when you're on pitch; otherwise it tells you to go higher or lower, without giving away the note. At the end you see what you sang next to each target note. Octaves don't matter.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. The microphone is used only when you turn it on; sound is analysed on your device, never recorded and never sent anywhere. Works offline.

Available in Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and Chinese.
